How to WatchWatch Sunday Night Baseball on NBC and Peacock.With a season-long lineup of Sunday Night Baseball games, NBC and Peacock are hitting the field in a big way in 2026. It’s the first time in more than 25 years that MLB baseball has been in regular rotation on the NBC Sports calendar, and it all begins with an awesome MLB Opening Day doubleheader on NBC and Peacock. When does the MLB season get underway in 2026? Keep scrolling for all you need to know!RELATED: Sunday Night Baseball: Full 2026 Schedule for MLB Games on NBC & PeacockWhen does the 2026 Major League Baseball season begin?The official start of the 2026 MLB season happens Wednesday, March 25 when the New York Yankees visit the San Francisco Giants for a standalone “Opening Night” game at 8:05 p.m. ET. Thursday, March 26 marks the traditional Opening Day of the 2026 MLB season, featuring a full schedule of 14 games — including an Opening Day pair on NBC and Peacock. RELATED: MLB Spring Training 2026: How Many Games Are There? How Does it Work? What to KnowWhat Opening Day MLB games are on NBC & Peacock?March 26 at 1 p.m. ET, the 2025 National League Cy Young Award Winner Paul Skenes and his Pittsburgh Pirates will take on Juan Soto and the New York Mets at New York’s Citi Field. Then, in the only prime time game on the Opening Day schedule, the Arizona Diamondbacks face off against back-to-back World Series champs the Los Angeles Dodgers in an 8:30 p.m. ET game from Dodger Stadium. Both MLB games in NBC Sports’ Opening Day doubleheader will be broadcast live on NBC and stream in simulcast on Peacock. After that, Sunday Night Baseball gets into its regular-season groove on Peacock when weekly MLB games swings into action on Sunday, March 29. Once NBC’s Sunday Night Basketball calendar clears at the end of the NBA season, NBC will join in the weekly broadcast mix with Sunday Night Baseball games that span the rest of the 2026 MLB season.Want to scope the full 2026 MLB schedule on NBC and Peacock?
